summary.decision_summary: Pat Pidgeon won by 20.0. Pat Pidgeon left 26.3 lineup points on the table, while Two Buck Luck left 2.7.

summary.ideal_summary: Ideal lineups still favor Pat Pidgeon
summary.winner_reason: Pat Pidgeon won by 20.0, led by a 19.4-point edge at WR. The leading starters were Jahmyr Gibbs (45.4) and Jaxon Smith-Njigba (34.3).
summary.loser_reason: Two Buck Luck could not match the opponent's WR production, losing that position battle by 19.4 points. 49ers scored 1.0. A best legal lineup added 2.7, still short of the 20.0-point margin.
